name: Mailtrap Local Email Sandbox
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local SMTP email catcher with web UI, JSON API, HTML compatibility checks and SQLite storage; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Local single-developer tool, not Mailtrap's hosted Email API or cloud Sandbox. No team accounts, authentication, multi-tenancy or high availability; macOS/Linux builds, Windows not yet supported. Default localhost-only SMTP/HTTP ports 3535/3550; releasing messages to a real SMTP provider can incur separate charges.
